Like other models in the family, it responds to user queries and tasks by first generating a reasoning trace and then concluding with a final response. The model's reasoning capabilities can be configured through a flag in the chat template.

profile.name: o3-pro
profile.summary: Version of o3 with more compute for better responses
profile.description: The o-series of models are trained with reinforcement learning to think before they answer and perform complex reasoning. The o3-pro model uses more compute to think harder and provide consistently better answers.

profile.name: o4-mini
profile.summary: Fast, cost-efficient reasoning model, succeeded by GPT-5 mini
profile.description: o4-mini is our latest small o-series model. It's optimized for fast, effective reasoning with exceptionally efficient performance in coding and visual tasks. It's succeeded by GPT-5 mini.

profile.name: o4-mini-deep-research
profile.summary: Retired deep research model
profile.description: o4-mini-deep-research searched public web sources and private data from MCP connectors to answer multi-step research questions. The model shut down on July 23, 2026.

profile.name: omni-moderation
profile.summary: Identify potentially harmful content in text and images
profile.description: Moderation models are free models designed to detect harmful content. This model is our most capable moderation model, accepting images as input as well. You can find the model card here.

profile.name: text-embedding-3-large
profile.summary: Most capable embedding model
profile.description: text-embedding-3-large is our most capable embedding model for both english and non-english tasks. Embeddings are a numerical representation of text that can be used to measure the relatedness between two pieces of text. Embeddings are useful for search, clustering, recommendations, anomaly detection, and classification tasks.

profile.name: text-embedding-3-small
profile.summary: Small embedding model
profile.description: text-embedding-3-small is our improved, more performant version of our ada embedding model. Embeddings are a numerical representation of text that can be used to measure the relatedness between two pieces of text. Embeddings are useful for search, clustering, recommendations, anomaly detection, and classification tasks.

profile.name: text-embedding-ada-002

profile.description: text-embedding-ada-002 is our improved, more performant version of our ada embedding model. Embeddings are a numerical representation of text that can be used to measure the relatedness between two pieces of text. profile.name: text-moderation
profile.summary: Previous generation text-only moderation model
profile.description: Moderation models are free models designed to detect harmful content. This is our text only moderation model; we expect omni-moderation-* models to be the best default moving forward.

profile.name: text-moderation-stable
profile.summary: Previous generation text-only moderation model
profile.description: Moderation models are free models designed to detect harmful content. This is our text only moderation model; we expect omni-moderation-* models to be the best default moving forward.

profile.name: TTS-1
profile.summary: Text-to-speech model optimized for speed
profile.description: TTS is a model that converts text to natural sounding spoken text. The tts-1 model is optimized for realtime text-to-speech use cases. Use it with the Speech endpoint in the Audio API.

profile.name: TTS-1 HD
profile.summary: Text-to-speech model optimized for quality
profile.description: TTS is a model that converts text to natural sounding spoken text. The tts-1-hd model is optimized for high quality text-to-speech use cases. Use it with the Speech endpoint in the Audio API.

profile.name: Whisper
profile.summary: General-purpose speech recognition model
profile.description: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model, trained on a large dataset of diverse audio. You can also use it as a multitask model to perform multilingual speech recognition as well as speech translation and language identification.
